fault_desc: unlogged wrong port, then benign payment release
diagnosis: Checkout's PAYMENT_ADDR is payment:9999, but the payment service and pod serve gRPC on 8080 (Service port 8080, containerPort 8080, log 'listening on 0.0.0.0:8080'). Checkout's payment calls therefore fail, which shows up as checkout HTTP 500s and then ReadTimeouts through frontend-proxy. The payment rollout (release 1.8.3, 17:36:53) coincided with the failures, but payment itself looks healthy. I did not confirm whether the 9999 value predates this rollout, since I did not inspect the previous checkout ReplicaSet's env, so the cause could also be the checkout rollout at 17:36:51. Patching the env var to the correct port is the smallest safe change.
